maps.purpose: Make participation, status and exclusion visible without treating institutional status as equal political power.
maps.center: Global South legibility; no country treated as the natural centre.
maps.uncertainty: Saudi Arabia membership status remains an open contradiction.
maps.nonvisual_equivalent: Country-by-country table with role, source, date, uncertainty and relationship to the summit.

maps.purpose: Show the difference between African full members, partner countries, states outside the architecture and the institutions invoked in Global South rhetoric.
maps.projection: Equal Earth plus declared comparison transforms where necessary
maps.uncertainty: National roles do not represent all communities, public institutions or civil society.
maps.nonvisual_equivalent: Table of African states and institutions with role, source, relationship and absence disclosure.

maps.purpose: Trace how publicly documented conflict and sea-lane disruption connect to food, fuel, medicine, work and humanitarian access.
maps.projection: Regional projection selected after route and distance review
maps.uncertainty: No real-time vessel movements or militarised locations are published as neutral logistics data.
maps.nonvisual_equivalent: Chronological table of corridor, event, verified effect, source and what cannot be inferred.

maps.purpose: Test where payment and local-currency announcements become usable routes for people and small businesses.
maps.projection: Equal Earth for global comparison; regional view only where a verified corridor is documented
maps.uncertainty: Proposed, piloting and operational corridors remain distinct states.
maps.nonvisual_equivalent: Corridor table with status, operator, fee, eligibility, access provisions, source and date.

maps.purpose: Test who supplies material and energy inputs for AI infrastructure and who receives control and benefit.
maps.projection: Equal Earth; any distortion transform states its variable and method
maps.uncertainty: Resource location does not establish ownership, labour conditions, local value capture or public benefit.
maps.nonvisual_equivalent: Source-to-control table that separates extraction, processing, compute, data, ownership and public benefit evidence.

maps.purpose: Track whether summit initiatives become funded projects, services and accountable outcomes.
maps.projection: Map-specific; every view declares its projection and its relevance
maps.uncertainty: Empty territory is a finding, not a reason to infer delivery.
maps.nonvisual_equivalent: Initiative table with status, location, budget, responsibility, source, date and missing evidence.
